title: Roast Chicken with Mediterranean Twist
description: A classic Italian roasted chicken with a hint of Mediterranean flavors. Perfect for a family dinner.
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the chicken.
Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken on all sides until browned, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a roasting pan and roast in the preheated oven for 45-50 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
While the chicken is roasting, mix the minced garlic and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Brush the garlic-lemon mixture over the chicken during the last 15 minutes of roasting.
Let the chicken rest for 10 minutes before carving and serving.
Garnish with chopped spring onions, if desired.
